name: Single cell atlas of the human trabecular meshwork and ciliary body - snRNA-seq
description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 1M cells, derived from single-nucleus RNA-seq data of the human trabecular meshwork and ciliary body. These cells have been categorized into 9 major classes and 18 sub-classes.

labels.name: Baylor College of Medicine Lions Eye Bank
Utah Lions Eye Bank, Florida Lions Eye Bank

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: This cell annotation set focuses on the trabecular meshwork (TM) and ciliary body (CB), key tissues regulating aqueous humor dynamics and intraocular pressure in the human eye. Using single-nucleus RNA-seq, we analyzed over 1 million cells from 70 healthy donors, identifying 9 major cell classes and 18 sub-classes. As part of the Human Cell Atlas initiative, this dataset integrates transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility data and is publicly accessible via CELLxGENE and the UCSC Cell Browser, offering a valuable resource for understanding ocular physiology and disease mechanisms.
